definition.label: Conservative latent12 spline expert on56k
definition.head_gap_caveat: Head gap is the unchanged V25 Kumo correction; new56k spline train and held-out metrics are recorded separately in optimization.
definition.formula: Preserve corrected Kumo and cached original spline. Fit standalone logistic GAM on identical56k outer-training rows, signedlog, median fill, quadratic3-knot quantile splines on continuous inputs, linear discrete inputs, explicit missing/categorical terms; meanBCE+.01/2||beta||^2 via C=1/(56000*.01), intercept unpenalized. No group-specific effects. Final=.95p_V25+.05p_newGAM; p_V25=.75p_correctedKumo+.25p_originalSpline. Fixed5% new contribution, no outer weight/route selection; mean5foldtest.
definition.rationale: Peer ALL66 obtained exploratory0.53401 but cross-fitted selection0.530402 and public0.55983. Its broad spline/population work motivates testing the secondary branch under a fixed small contribution, not copying selected routing/global-prevalence shifts. Our current18-input correction sees only6k labels; a separate latent spline can use all56k while keeping the Kumo branch exact. V254 tests latent12, V255 adds existing six evidence-count inputs, V256 adds predefined coverage interactions. All reuse information already inV25; no gain is assumed.
